rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout requires >5 attempts: identifier = f'{request.client.host}:{email}' but the app runs behind K8s ingress → request.client.host is the ingress pod IP which rotates. Each rotated IP has its own failure counter, so 5 consecutive failures don't reliably accumulate under one key. Fix: use request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for', request.client.host).split(',')[0].strip() as the host component, or use email-only for identifier (accept the trade-off of denial-of-service on legitimate users).
